title: You’re Late, Rabbit
meta_description: You’re Late, Rabbit is an in-progress branching horror quest set in a glitter-pink house, where the viewer is handed a numbered choice at every reveal.
role: Concept, art direction, generative production, edit
deck: An in-progress vertical horror quest built in two parts, where a glitter-pink house turns hostile and the viewer is handed a numbered choice at the exact moment they would rather look away.

proof.title: Pink first, then the thing in the doorway.
proof.note: The whole set is lit like a birthday. Holographic vinyl, sequin walls, sugar-pink light through every door. The horror is not introduced by a change of grade, it simply walks into a room that stays exactly as sweet as it was.

shots.alt: A two-storey house wrapped entirely in glittering pink foil and sequin curtains, with pink steps, pink planters and flowers, under a clear blue sky.
shots.caption: Location / the house

shots.alt: A young woman with a black blunt fringe standing in a mint-green floral kitchen wearing a glitter crop top and iridescent silver flared trousers, a pink glowing doorway behind her.
shots.caption: Part 1 / before

shots.alt: Close portrait of the masked figure, pale seamed face with blacked-out eyes and antler-like horns, against a rose-tinted kitchen.
shots.caption: Part 1 / the reveal

shots.alt: The doorway shot blurred behind a game-style overlay reading What was THAT with two numbered options offering to leave or to continue, a mouse cursor hovering.
shots.caption: Part 1 / the choice

proof.caption: Every reveal ends in a menu. The overlay is deliberately cheap — hand-lettered options, a visible cursor — so the moment of fear is interrupted by something that looks like a game from 2004.

acts.title: Two parts, one branch each.
acts.note: The quest is not a story with an ending, it is a set of doors. Each part builds to a reveal and then stops to ask the viewer whether they are still in.

items.title: The house
items.copy: A pink interior, a girl dressed to match it, and something already standing in the next room.

items.title: “What was THAT!!!”
items.copy: Two numbered options: leave now, or continue. The blur holds until you pick.

items.title: The rabbit
items.copy: The masked figure gets a face, a close-up, and the run of the house.

pipeline.title: Pipeline.
pipeline.note: Shot as vertical stills, animated in passes, then cut into two parts with the branch points written into the edit rather than bolted on afterwards.

items.label: Dress
items.copy: One palette of glitter, foil and sequin, applied to house, wardrobe and light alike.

items.label: Cast
items.copy: Two figures only: the girl who belongs in the room and the one who does not.

items.label: Animate
items.copy: Vertical stills brought to motion, keeping the flat front-on framing of a doorway.

items.label: Branch
items.copy: Choice overlays timed to the reveal, cut so the menu lands on the held frame.
